fields.title: LinkedIn account activity record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of an account's public posting activity. One ACCOUNT row per person or company with derived content metrics, one POST row per analysed post, NOTICE rows where LinkedIn embedded no posts, and ERROR rows on failure. LinkedIn changes its markup without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The profile or company URL that produced this record.

_source.title: Source surface
_source.description: guest-profile-page, guest-company-page, or none on NOTICE and ERROR rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: fetch_failed or auth_required.

_notice.title: Notice
_notice.description: Explains a non-failure empty result, such as no_public_posts.

_noticeDetail.title: Notice detail
_noticeDetail.description: What the notice means and what to change.

accountName.title: Account
accountName.description: The person's or company's display name.

accountType.title: Account type
accountType.description: PERSON or COMPANY. The two behave differently: company pages embed no engagement data.

accountUrl.title: Account URL
accountUrl.description: Canonical LinkedIn link, tracking parameters stripped.

headline.title: Headline / tagline
headline.description: The member's headline or the company's tagline.

followers.title: Followers
followers.description: Follower count - the denominator behind engagementRatePct.

postsAnalysed.title: Posts analysed
postsAnalysed.description: How many posts this row is based on. LinkedIn embeds roughly the last 6-10 per account, so read every metric here as describing that window and nothing wider.

daysCovered.title: Days covered
daysCovered.description: Span between the oldest and newest analysed post.

postsPerWeek.title: Posts per week
postsPerWeek.description: Publishing cadence over the covered window.

firstPostAt.title: Oldest post
firstPostAt.description: Timestamp of the oldest analysed post.

lastPostAt.title: Newest post
lastPostAt.description: Timestamp of the newest analysed post - also a liveness check on whether the account is still active.

avgReactions.title: Average reactions
avgReactions.description: Mean reactions per analysed post. Null when engagement data was not available.

medianReactions.title: Median reactions
medianReactions.description: Median reactions per post. Usually the more honest figure: one viral post skews the mean badly.

maxReactions.title: Best post reactions
maxReactions.description: Reactions on their strongest analysed post.

engagementRatePct.title: Engagement rate %
engagementRatePct.description: Average reactions divided by followers, as a percentage. The only metric here that compares accounts of different sizes fairly.

engagementDataAvailable.title: Engagement data available
engagementDataAvailable.description: False for company pages unless post-level engagement fetching was enabled - company pages embed no reaction counts, and this actor reports that as missing rather than as zero.

topHashtags.title: Top hashtags
topHashtags.description: Most-used hashtags across the analysed posts, lowercased.

hashtagUsagePct.title: Hashtag usage %
hashtagUsagePct.description: Share of analysed posts that used any hashtag at all.

mediaMix.title: Media mix
mediaMix.description: Counts by post format - TEXT, LINK, ARTICLE - showing what the account actually publishes.

avgTextLength.title: Average post length
avgTextLength.description: Mean characters per post, a usable proxy for whether they write short hooks or long essays.

articleShare.title: Article share %
articleShare.description: Percentage of analysed posts that were long-form articles.

bestPostUrl.title: Best post URL
bestPostUrl.description: Link to their strongest analysed post.

bestPostText.title: Best post text
bestPostText.description: First 400 characters of their strongest post - the fastest way to see what worked.

postText.title: Post text
postText.description: POST rows: the post body as published.

reactions.title: Reactions
reactions.description: POST rows: reaction count, or null where LinkedIn published none.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: POST rows: hashtags used in that post.

mediaType.title: Media type
mediaType.description: POST rows: TEXT, LINK or ARTICLE.

textLength.title: Text length
textLength.description: POST rows: characters in the post body.
